subject.title: feat: broker portable ready-pool access and desired capacity

question: What coordinator security and configuration contract should govern portable per-borrow access grants and desired ready-pool capacity across providers?
rationale: The implementation requires explicit choices about credential issuance and revocation, persisted-state evolution, capacity defaults, cost controls, and phased AWS/Azure support that cannot be inferred safely from existing behavior.

options.title: Approve a phased contract
options.body: Specify the provider-neutral grant and capacity schemas first, land one provider with migration and adversarial lifecycle tests, then add additional providers behind the same adapter contract.

options.title: Keep access client-local
options.body: Limit ready pools to clients that already possess the lease credential and pursue only safer reconciliation, pruning, and capacity controls.

options.title: Defer the broader pool service
options.body: Retain explicit count-then-create behavior and the existing reuse safety fixes until portable access has a separately sponsored security design.

recommendation.title: Approve a phased contract
recommendation.body: Specify the provider-neutral grant and capacity schemas first, land one provider with migration and adversarial lifecycle tests, then add additional providers behind the same adapter contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most closely to the ready-pool lifecycle design and its recent safety hardening.
